notes.title: Demo Feedback
notes.content:
Hello everyones! First of all I'm really glad that so many people subscribe to Disobey's Community Hub, so thanks you all for the support. 



Just two days ago we released the first playable demo of Disobey (here on steam just for windows - if you need mac version you can find it here http://www.indiedb.com/games/disobey/downloads/disobey-revolt-simulator-demo-mac). 

[img]http://www.tunnelvision.it/disobey/fbadv5.png[/img]

Like we wrote in the demo description, it's still full of bugs and imperfections, graphics and animations are totally primitive, player and camera controllers still don't work like we want, and i could continue to list thousands of other problems.

[img]http://www.tunnelvision.it/disobey/fbadv2.png[/img]

Despite of that demo is barely playable, our intent is to have feedbacks from the community about game's dynamics and logic, to develop a better video game.

[img]http://www.tunnelvision.it/disobey/fbadv3.png[/img]

So we'll be pleased to have feedbacks (all kinds, positive and negative)  from all the people who tried the demo!

[img]http://www.tunnelvision.it/disobey/fbadv4.png[/img]

And don't forget about Kickstarter! 
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1448085388/disobey-revolt-simulator?ref=home_social

notes.title: Disobey is now LIVE on Kickstarter
notes.content:
[h1] Disobey on Kickstarter [/h1]

[img]http://disobeythegame.co/images/kick2.jpg[/img]

Finally we reach the last stage of our game-developing journey: Kickstarter! 
Disobey – Revolt Simulator Campaign is now live on this link

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1448085388/disobey-revolt-simulator?ref=home_social] KICKSTARTER [/url]
 
When we started to work to Disobey we knew that it would have been impossible to realize the game alone. We have always known that one day we would have asked help to someone. So, we decided to ask directly to the community.

Kickstarter is a testbed and a springboard at the same time. If the community likes you they will help you to create your project.
For that reason, before developing the entire game, we started the campaign hoping to not gather just money but also suggestions and advices to develop a better game.

So don’t miss the opportunity and SPREAD THE WORD!
